summary: Slot 2 (a balanced tree): run 5 with the MCTS child mix set by one rule instead of fixed all-random. Each wave, the sampled child that beat its siblings (on the tree's value, else on new cells of a live child) earns its kind (policy sample / perturbed / random-held) a point; shares = probability matching per child, floor 5%, horizon 16 waves (--mcts-mix-rule sib, commit 8c606b5f). Bench on box 59951396 (RTX 5080) running; the from-scratch run launches right after it.
